basis: Малый 28 Dec 1904: scan-confirmed print typo "Женихъ" for Gogol's "Женитьба" (its subtitle "совершенно невѣроятное событіе"; the Новый prints "Женитьба, соверш. невѣр. событіе" on 31 Dec 1904). Matching only; the printed title stays verbatim (RG, 2026-10-05).
Gogol's subtitle spelled out in full, which the compound-suffix rule (abbreviations only) does not strip. Same work.
